abstract.#text: John Wooden is one of the most respected and honored sports coaches in our nation's history. But it wasn't winning games that drove him; it was ensuring that, regardless of the final score, his players always put forth their utmost effort and performed to the best of their abilities. One of his lesser-known aspects is the notebooks in which he regularly recorded his thoughts, inspirations, and life lessons. Here, the coach and his longtime collaborator Steve Jamison combine the best of those notebooks with his Pyramid of Success to create a leadership skills guide designed to help anyone develop character, conviction, and achievement.--From publisher description.

titleInfo.title: essential Wooden
titleInfo.subTitle: a lifetime of lessons on leaders and leadership

abstract.#text: This is a collection of coach John Wooden's thoughts and advice on what it takes to achieve exceptional leadership in any organization. This book offers 200 key lessons--including Wooden's famous Pyramid of Success--on how to inspire championship performance in staff. Every aspect of his leadership philosophy is in here--from personal drive and dedication to making one's vision known and optimism.

tableOfContents.#text: Leadership, values, victory and success -- Preparation and training of a team -- Maintaining the competitive edge -- Notes to myself.
